CustomField.description: Marks Contact 2 of this row as the household's primary member (the head of household) for Nonprofit Cloud Household conversion. On the main submission Contact 2 is the second person; on a related row of a Contact 2 repeater it is the relative, so this is the flag to carry when the applicant is a child and the parent on the repeater row is the head. The base package never writes household memberships, so the field is inert here; the Nonprofit Cloud extension's Household engine reads it: the membership written for a flagged row takes the primary seat and the previous primary member of that Household is demoted, so a Household always has exactly one. When no row is flagged, the first person added to the Household stays its primary member.
CustomField.label: Primary Contact
